verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe girahee aakheean ketaRiaa(n) lakh firan udhaasee|

en.bdb: Many are householders and millions are spending indifferent life.
Many are Yogisuras (great yogis) and many are Sanniasi.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)niaasee dhas naam dhar jogee baareh pa(n)th nivaasee|

en.bdb: Sanniasi are of then names and yogis have been divided into twelve sects.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਕਿਤੜੇ ਬਾਨਪ੍ਰਸਤ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) lakh param ha(n)s kitaRe baanaprasat banavaasee|

en.bdb: Many are ascetics of highest order (paramhans) and many are living in the jungles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਡੰਡ ਧਾਰ ਕਿਤੜੇ ਜੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਦੈਆਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) hee dda(n)dd dhaar kitaRe jainee jeea dhaiaasee|

en.bdb: Many keep sticks in the hands and many are compassionate Jains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਘਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਭੇਸ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia ghar chhia gur aakheean chhia upadhes bhes abhiaasee|

en.bdb: Six are the Shastras, six their teachers and six their guises, disciplines and teachings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਇਕੋ ਬਾਰਹ ਰਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baareh maeh kar sooraj iko baareh raasee|

en.bdb: Six seasons and twelve months are there but moving into each of the twelve zodiac signs the sun is the only one.
The Guru of the gurus, the true Guru (God) is indestructible).
